wordplay_note: A quail — timid and hunted, yet secretly extraordinary
card_description: Quail (Douglas) (meaning "Quail = small timid bird") is a character in Philip K. Dick's *We Can Remember It for You Wholesale*. Clerk who discovers his implanted memories of a Mars mission are real. Name note: A quail — timid and hunted, yet secretly extraordinary. False memory and true identity — the small man who is secretly the most important person alive. First appears in *We Can Remember It for You Wholesale*.
